status: Concept design; fabrication and environmental release gates remain open
description: Standalone welded dry enclosure for one AM59-3S-64-64 amplifier and four recessed Seifert 3050303 thermoelectric coolers. Two coolers are placed symmetrically on each long wall. Removable secondary immersion caps provide the proposed unpowered IPX7 boundary; the coolers themselves remain IP66 components.

coordinate_system.x: AM59 airflow and RF-output direction; factory fans at -X, output at +X
coordinate_system.y: Across the AM59 mounting flange and between opposed cooler banks

environmental_modes.operating: Cooler-bank immersion caps removed. Complete populated enclosure targets IP6X and IPX6 after test. All connectors mated or capped.
environmental_modes.washdown: RF inhibited and +50 V amplifier supply isolated. Limit washdown to the qualified IPX6 procedure unless a higher-pressure test is added.
environmental_modes.temporary_immersion: Unpowered, all external connectors capped, both cooler-bank immersion caps installed and interlocks proven, 1 m / 30 min IPX7 target on the complete populated enclosure.
environmental_modes.important_limit: No IPX7 claim is made with either immersion cap removed because Seifert rates the complete 3050303 only IP66 / Type 4X.

sealed_enclosure.material: 5052-H32 aluminum, continuously welded; final alloy/temper after weld procedure qualification
sealed_enclosure.roof_drainage: Production roof requires a 3 to 5 degree crown/slope; the CAD roof is a packaging plane.
sealed_enclosure.pressure_boundary: All seams continuous. No stitch welds, rivets, ordinary drains, or unsealed structural fasteners through the dry boundary.

service_lid.fastener_thread: M5 A4-80 captive screw into replaceable blind insert outside the seal
service_lid.safety_interlock: Dual-channel lid-open sensing inhibits RF and removes +50 V before fastener removal; verify stored-energy discharge before access.
service_lid.release_note: Final gland, fastener preload, lid deflection, compression stops, tolerances, and torque require selected-seal data and structural analysis.

cartridge.material: 6061-T6 aluminum, hard-anodized or conversion-coated as required
cartridge.retention: Use all twelve OEM mounting points. The tray bears on two welded floor rails, seats against two fixed +X stops, and is captured by two removable -X retainers before the service lid is installed.
cartridge.bonding: A dedicated flexible bonding strap bridges the removable cartridge to a prepared enclosure bond stud; rail contact is not the sole RF/protective bond.

seifert_3050303.mounting: Recessed, two units on +Y and two units on -Y
seifert_3050303.dimension_reconciliation: The supplied STEP/drawing govern concept packaging. Reconcile them against the purchased serial-number drawing and preserve at least 3 mm growth allowance before release.
seifert_3050303.rating: IP66 / UL Type 12, 4, 4X as a complete cooler; ambient fan IP68
seifert_3050303.capacity_curve_note: Values are conservative graph readings from the supplied 3050-family performance curve and require calorimeter confirmation.
seifert_3050303.airflow_control: Every cabinet-side fan runs continuously while the enclosure is energized. Each ambient fan and Peltier element is switched as a pair. Monitor each branch independently.

internal_air_management.production_flow_acceptance_limit: TBD after fan-curve/system-resistance correlation to passing thermal tests; 63 m3/h free-air sum is not an installed-flow requirement.
internal_air_management.service_baffle: The -X cold-drop baffle is captive to the removable service module and must be removed with the lid before cartridge extraction.
internal_air_management.note: Baffles are pressure-drop and routing envelopes. Final port mapping, duct boots, fan interaction, operating points, and delivered airflow require the purchased cooler, the exact AM59, and a production-equivalent prototype.

condensation_management.strategy: Prevent condensation by dew-point control; catch and detect fault condensate without an open drain.
condensation_management.sensors: One leak strip or point sensor per tray plus enclosure RH/temperature and cold-sink temperature.
condensation_management.service_response: Any condensate detection inhibits RF, records the event, and requires inspection/dry-out before manual reset.
condensation_management.prohibited: No open condensate tube, trap, check valve, or ordinary drain through the IP67 pressure boundary.

immersion_caps.material: Formed 5052-H32 aluminum pan with four welded external vertical ribs and machined compression flange
immersion_caps.fasteners: Thirty-two captive M6 compression fasteners per cap through the removable flange into blind welded coaming studs/bosses at 48 mm maximum pitch; no fastener penetrates the dry wall. Provide hard compression stops.
immersion_caps.interlock: Two-channel, fail-safe cap-present interlock on each bank removes TEC, fan, RF-enable, and amplifier power before a cap can be fully seated.
immersion_caps.use_limit: Caps block the ambient airflow and are never installed while the enclosure is energized. They are required for the proposed unpowered IPX7 configuration.
immersion_caps.qualification: Complete populated enclosure, both caps, all connector caps, production seals, and representative cables require IPX7 testing.

controller.role: The modeled internal envelope is low-power safety I/O only. Locate high-current cooler switching, branch protection, and the 24 V supply in ground/support equipment so their heat and arc energy remain outside the dry RF enclosure.
controller.cooler_power_supply: Ground/support-equipment 24 VDC supply, 20 A minimum continuous rating. Do not put the 48-to-24 V converter or high-current branch switching in the dry enclosure.
controller.feeder: 24 V feeder, connector, and wiring sized for voltage drop, 14.8 A simultaneous starting current, fault current, and ambient derating.
controller.branches: Four independent 4 A time-delay fused and current-monitored branches.
sensors: Two immersion-cap interlock channels per bank

fault_modes.four_coolers_healthy: Up to the qualified 300 W enclosure heat basis.
fault_modes.three_coolers_healthy: Automatically limit estimated dissipation to 200 W maximum.
fault_modes.two_coolers_healthy: Automatically limit estimated dissipation to 125 W maximum.
fault_modes.one_or_zero_coolers_healthy: RF inhibit and remove +50 V amplifier power.
fault_modes.case_at_63c: Complete derating to zero and apply independent hardware RF inhibit.
fault_modes.case_at_64c: Remove +50 V amplifier power and latch the fault.
fault_modes.case_at_or_above_65c: Qualification failure requiring engineering review; not a normal control point.
fault_modes.cooler_bank_inlet_above_60c: RF inhibit regardless of cooler count.
fault_modes.any_cap_present: Remove TEC, fan, RF-enable, and amplifier power.

feedthroughs.high_power_rf: Qualified barrier-sealed feedthrough or factory-potted pigtail for 2998 MHz, +64 dBm peak pulse, maximum duty, altitude, and worst allowed mismatch. Generic N hardware is not released.
feedthroughs.other_ports: Separate qualified 24 V cooler-power, +50 V/-8 V/control, and low-power RF feedthroughs. Exact holes remain supplier-suffix dependent.
feedthroughs.pressure_vent: Supplier-sized IP68/IP69K screw-in ePTFE vent on a sheltered high fixed wall, included in IPX7 testing.
feedthroughs.caps: Every external connector requires a tethered equal-rated cap; mated and capped configurations both require qualification.
feedthroughs.strain_relief: External and internal cables are supported independently; connector bodies carry no cable bending load.

sun_shields.note: Freely ventilated solar shields only. They are not rain covers or ingress barriers and must not restrict the combined 256 m3/h ambient airflow.

qualification_targets.production_leak_screen: 100 percent correlated pressure-decay or tracer-gas test with vent temporarily blocked and cooler-bank interfaces included
qualification_targets.thermal: A calibrated net 300 W dry-boundary load at a maximum 45 C hottest cooler-bank inlet, reduced supply voltage, production shields, and four healthy coolers. Equipment heat plus measured residual solar ingress must total 300 W; do not add an unquantified solar load to a separate 300 W heater. Repeat the defined 200 W and 125 W degraded corners.
qualification_targets.airflow: Correlate AM59 and Seifert fan curves, measured system resistance, branch pressure/flow, and passing thermal results. Establish a configuration-controlled production flow/pressure limit; do not use the AM59 63 m3/h free-air sum as installed acceptance.
qualification_targets.ingress_operating: Separate IP6X and IPX6 on the populated normal operating configuration
qualification_targets.ingress_immersion: IPX7, 1 m / 30 min, unpowered, both immersion caps installed, production connector caps fitted
qualification_targets.thermal_cycling: Prove gasket compression, cooler interfaces, pressure cycling, dew-point control, and restart behavior over the released temperature range
qualification_targets.corrosion: Actual site salt, cleaner, UV, coating, galvanic-isolation, and bonding exposure
qualification_targets.operating_ambient: Provisional 300 W full-power limit is 45 C at the hottest measured cooler-bank inlet with four healthy coolers. Above the qualified health/ambient table the controller selects the next lower heat mode; above 60 C at either bank inlet RF is inhibited.
qualification_targets.storage_and_cold_start: Release the complete-system storage range as the intersection of all component limits. Seifert transport/storage is -40 to 70 C and 95 percent RH at 25 C; AM59 cold-soak/start limits and any heater/start-inhibit strategy remain qualification gates.
qualification_targets.emc: Qualify radiated/conducted susceptibility and emissions, switching transients, bonding, and interlock integrity with the pulsed 3 GHz amplifier operating at worst case.
qualification_targets.acceptance: No free water, dust, wet witness label, insulation loss, bond degradation, thermal fault, RF degradation, or permanent seal set outside limits

release_gates: Measure AM59 case-to-enclosure-air rise at the 300 W heat basis. Four coolers are not acceptable if the case exceeds 65 C with enclosure air controlled near 55 C.
Obtain Seifert serial-number-controlled dimensions, gasket data, installation instructions, mounting surface tolerances, terminal diagram, and fan/Peltier control details.
Reconcile the supplied 206 x 153.5 x 134.9 mm STEP against the current 200 x 154 x 138 mm catalog envelope.
Select and release the high-power RF feedthrough and cable by pulse-power, VSWR, insertion-loss, altitude, temperature-rise, and ingress test.
Complete lid/cap deflection analysis, gasket gland tolerancing, weld procedure qualification, and populated enclosure ingress tests.
Commission airflow with production-equivalent baffles and verify cooler and AM59 fan interaction.
Correlate an installed fan operating-point/thermal acceptance limit; the 63 m3/h AM59 free-air sum is reference information only.
Qualify dew-point control and fault-condensate containment without an open drain.
Verify corrosion isolation and intentional protective bonding between stainless coolers, aluminum enclosure, fasteners, cartridge, and cable shields.
Close mass, center-of-gravity, lifting/handling, cartridge retention, cooler cantilever, cap/lid hydrostatic, shock/vibration, and transport-load substantiation.
Qualify the lid and cap safety interlocks, stored-energy discharge, and EMC/EMI performance before service or environmental release.
